title: Buddha's Wall of Delight
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and Turkish flavors, perfect for a delicious and quick dinner.
instructions: Cut the pita bread into triangles and toast until crispy.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped lettuce, sliced tomato, and sliced cucumber.
In a separate bowl, mix together the hummus and Turkish Zesty Sauce.
Add the Chinese Five-Spice Powder to the hummus mixture and stir well.
Spoon the hummus mixture over the lettuce mixture and toss to coat.
Divide the salad among four plates and top each plate with toasted pita bread.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, serve immediately.
Optional: garnish with additional pita bread croutons or sesame seeds.
